name: Scatterbrain
avoid_for: Contexts that demand precision and institutional weight — the post-it sticky-note aesthetic intentionally reads as warm and unfinished
weak_cases: Overlapping notes reduce reading clarity; chart geometry must encode the actual values rather than preserve specimen shapes.
visual_signature: Pastel sticky notes on cork or paper, soft shadows, thumbtacks, tape and Shrikhand display.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Chunky display, slab body and handwriting have different roles; another script needs deliberate equivalents, without adding Latin margin notes the audience did not request.

assets.images: Optional source photo in a Polaroid-style frame; backgrounds, pins and tape can be built in CSS/SVG.
